text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Yasuda Kinen had arrived. Sakura 
Chiyono O restlessly continued her 
preparations.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Convinced that "peaks" didn't matter to 
her, she vowed to prove that she was still 
right in the middle of her growth spurt.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Lying in wait for her was Bamboo Memory, 
who had just blossomed into full 
brilliance after switching from dirt to 
turf.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Facing rivals on a roll, Sakura Chiyono 
O's Yasuda Kinen begins.
